## Human verification

Setup: run `make dev` and open http://localhost:3000 in Firefox with the
`dev@example.com` test account.

1. Open http://localhost:3000/login and sign in with a wrong password.
   Expected: the form shows "Wrong email or password" under the password field.
2. Sign in with the right password.
   Expected: the dashboard opens and no error shows.
3. Sign out, then press Back in the browser.
   Expected: the login page shows again, not the dashboard (regression check).

Cleanup: none; the test account keeps no state.

Not verifiable here: the production identity provider.
